name: 55447 · Plymouth, MN
findings: ZIP 55447 (Plymouth) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55447 (Plymouth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
